description: Anonymized 20 Hz recorded model lead observations. Hypotheses are not object identities. Labels describe maneuver context and ambiguity, not confirmed lane clearance. No camera, GPS, route IDs, wall-clock or original monotonic times retained.
coordinates: Model calibrated FRD: x forward, y right. Speed is ego-aligned absolute current model speed. No future lead values.
precision: Scalar observations rounded to six decimal places; original cadence retained. Decisions must be timestamped at time + availability_delay. CS/deviceMotion source offsets are relative to model time. Yaw comes from latest received deviceMotion.angularVelocityDevice whose measurement timestamp precedes model time rotated by preceding calibrated extrinsicsCalibration.rpyCalib, with source flags and 100ms motion/2s calibration freshness checks. This scalar fixture has full logged source availability; separate caller replay checks the runtime subscriber buffers.
